newsitem.title: JAPAN: Iraq rolls over Jan crude formula to Asia - traders.
newsitem.headline: Iraq rolls over Jan crude formula to Asia - traders.

text.p: Iraq's state oil firm SOMO has set the price formula for January loading Basrah Light to Asia at a premium of 20 cents to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations, unchanged from December, traders said on Friday.
Traders said Iraq uses the monthly price formula of Saudi Arabia's Arab Light crude to Asia as a guide to set the price for Basrah Light.
Saudi Arabia rolled over the January price formula for Arab Light crude to Asia, which is a premium of 75 cents to the average of Oman and Dubai quotations, from December.

Mitsubishi Corp is believed to be the only Japanese company to have signed an agreement to buy Iraqi crude under the United Nations oil-for-food deal which allows Baghdad to sell $2 billion worth of oil, its first oil sales since sanctions were imposed after Baghdad's invasion of Kuwait in 1990.
The Japanese trading company is acting on behalf of five Japanese oil companies, which together will lift 40,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) from Iraq under a three-month agreement.
Japan was importing roughly 200,000 bpd of crude oil from Iraq before the United Nations imposed sanctions.
